name: appaudit
description: Non-destructive security assessments for systems you own or have the owner's written permission to test: web apps, APIs, mobile/IoT apps, firmware, AI agents, and plugins, skills and MCP servers before you install them. Enforced scope, hash-chained evidence, independent verification, regulatory flags for 9 jurisdictions, six audit-ready outputs. Not a certification.

update_source.title: Update source
update_source.description: Where the update check (the first step of every assessment) reads the published version. Default: the appaudit repository on GitHub. Set to "off" to disable the check. Nothing is ever downloaded or installed.

scanner_gate.title: Scanner gate
scanner_gate.description: What happens when a scanning or attack tool (nmap, sqlmap, nuclei and similar) is started while no appaudit engagement is open: "ask" (default) asks you first, "deny" blocks it, "off" disables this check.
